meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页交互与数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器执行重复操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions and extract web data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control a browser programmatically for repetitive tasks

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 能操控真实浏览器:打开网页、点击、填表、截图、读取页面内容,并让页面在多次操作间保持打开;在你已登录的 Chrome 上也能替你操作。
howto.when: 当你提出“打开某网址”、“点击”、“填表单”等浏览器操作需求,或要求截图、抓数据时触发;也可在你已登录网站时接管现有 Chrome。

say.text: 打开 example.com,截个图给我看
say.note: 会启动浏览器并保存页面截图

say.text: 在搜索框输入“hello”并点击搜索按钮
say.note: Claude 会用可访问性快照定位元素并操作

say.text: 抓取当前页面上的文章标题列表
say.note: 走网络请求抓取,不只靠滚动页面

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can drive a real browser: open pages, click, fill forms, take screenshots, and read page content. Pages stay open between steps, and it can also operate your existing logged-in Chrome.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to go to a URL, click, fill a form, take a screenshot, scrape data, test a website, or automate browser tasks. It can also connect to your existing Chrome session.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a screenshot for me
say_en.note: It will launch the browser and save a screenshot

say_en.text: Type "hello" in the search box and click the search button
say_en.note: Uses the accessibility snapshot to locate elements

say_en.text: Scrape the list of article titles from this page
say_en.note: Uses network request replay rather than just scrolling
